items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A file tree for code bundles, data exports and research folders, with folding folders, keyboard navigation and sizes on the right.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible sidebar navigation for SaaS admin panels and trading dashboards, with accordion sections, an active rail and a mobile drawer.

items.name: macos-dock
items.title: macOS Dock
items.description: A macOS style app dock with magnifying icons and a ⌘K command menu, for launchers and workspace switchers in trading and AI tools.

items.name: browser-window
items.title: Browser Window
items.description: A browser window mockup for showing a dashboard or web app on a landing page, in Chrome or Safari frames, with a phone layout under 480px.

items.name: macbook-frame
items.title: MacBook Frame
items.description: A MacBook mockup frame for product screenshots and live app embeds on landing pages, pitch decks and fintech case studies.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: A swipeable card stack carousel for product showcases and feature tours; drag the top card away or click it to open a detail modal.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: A responsive card grid for products, strategies or case studies, with hover actions on each card and a shared detail modal.

items.name: card-list
items.title: Card List
items.description: A vertical card list for reports, products or case studies, each card with media and copy, opening into a shared detail modal.

items.name: bento-gallery
items.title: Bento Gallery
items.description: A draggable bento grid gallery for product shots and dashboard screenshots that opens into a shared lightbox.

items.name: cutout-card
items.title: Cutout Card
items.description: Media card with a scooped-out content tray (concave corners), hover-reveal action button, and gradient overlay.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An accordion for feature and FAQ sections on product pages, each row opening to a body, a checklist and a screenshot.

items.name: project-card
items.title: Project Card
items.description: Shared cutout project card with blurred-gradient media and a liquid-metal hover ring.

items.name: historical-eps
items.title: Historical EPS
items.description: A quarterly EPS chart for stock research and earnings screens, with forecast against reported bars and the surprise on hover.

items.name: price-target-fan
items.title: Price Target Fan
items.description: An analyst price target chart for stock research: a year of price history, then projections fanning out to the high, mean and low targets.

items.name: market-watchlist
items.title: Market Watchlist
items.description: A watchlist that reads as one chart: every watched coin as a line from the same open, a row per coin, and the whole market beside it in tokens, sectors and yields, where any row adds itself to the list.

items.name: sma-chart
items.title: SMA Chart
items.description: A stock price chart with 20 and 50 day simple moving average overlays and crosshair scrubbing, for trading and technical analysis screens.

items.name: dotted-area-chart
items.title: Dotted Area Chart
items.description: A crypto price area chart on a dotted field; scrub it to light the stretch you have passed and read the price and move at any point.

items.name: health-gauge
items.title: Health Gauge
items.description: A gauge chart for margin ratio, fear and greed or liquidity scores, on a 270 degree dial that counts up and cycles metrics on click.

items.name: market-heatmap
items.title: Market Heatmap
items.description: A stock market heatmap with tiles sized by market cap and tinted by the daily move, for market overview and trading dashboards.

items.name: sankey-flow
items.title: Sankey Diagram
items.description: A Sankey diagram for cash flow, budgets and fund flows, where income pools in one hub and each ribbon width stands for the amount.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: A crypto portfolio donut chart that shows allocation as a ring with the total in the centre, the ring and its legend highlighting together.

items.name: balance-header
items.title: Balance Header
items.description: A wallet and bank balance header with the total, the 24h move and a privacy toggle that masks every figure, for crypto and fintech apps.

items.name: market-snapshot
items.title: Market Snapshot
items.description: A stock price card with periods from 1D to All and a line chart you scrub for the price at any moment, for broker and market apps.

items.name: index-card
items.title: Index Card
items.description: A market index card for the S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq and Russell, with tabs between indices and an intraday line you can scrub.

items.name: range-navigator
items.title: Range Navigator
items.description: A price history chart with a range selector minimap; drag the window to pan and pull an edge to zoom, for trading and analytics apps.

items.name: sectors-donut
items.title: Sectors Donut
items.description: A sector allocation donut for ETF and fund pages that shows each sector weight and dims the rest while you hover one.

items.name: ratings-radar
items.title: Ratings Radar
items.description: An analyst ratings chart for stock research pages, spreading strong buy to strong sell on a pentagon pulled toward the consensus.

items.name: analyst-radar
items.title: Analyst Radar
items.description: A factor score radar chart for equity research, comparing a company with its sector on value, growth, profit, momentum and quality.

items.name: kpi-card-row
items.title: KPI Card Row
items.description: A KPI card row for SaaS, AI and API dashboards, with metrics like requests and uptime counting up over area charts you can scrub.

items.name: heat-calendar
items.title: Heat Calendar
items.description: A calendar heatmap of daily activity such as transactions, trades or API calls, with a readout on hover and a selected span that totals the days.

items.name: returns-calendar
items.title: Returns Calendar
items.description: A monthly returns heatmap for funds, strategies and backtests, with a compounded yearly column and spans you select to compound returns.

items.name: holdings-table
items.title: Holdings Table
items.description: A fund holdings table with market value, price, YTD return and portfolio weight bars, sortable by any column, for ETF and wealth apps.

items.name: trade-journal-table
items.title: Trade Journal Table
items.description: A trade journal table for crypto and stock traders, with the open position lit and every closed trade settled to a win or loss.

items.name: fills-blotter
items.title: Fills Blotter
items.description: A live order fills blotter for brokers and trading desks, streaming executions that land as working and resolve to filled or rejected.

items.name: candlestick
items.title: Candlestick Chart
items.description: A candlestick chart with a volume histogram, a magnet crosshair and a live OHLC legend, for stock and crypto trading terminals.

items.name: equity-drawdown
items.title: Equity & Drawdown
items.description: An equity curve with a synced drawdown chart for backtests and trading performance, one crosshair reading return, drawdown and days below peak.

items.name: balance-chart
items.title: Balance Chart
items.description: A wallet balance chart for crypto and banking apps: an area line coloured by trend, with high and low marks and timeframes from 1H to All.

items.name: price-scrubber
items.title: Price Scrubber
items.description: A stock price chart you scrub with a magnet crosshair and price and time badges on the axes, the headline price turning green or red against the open.

items.name: comb-rows
items.title: Comb Rows
items.description: A peer comparison chart that draws each company as a ruler of ticks, for valuation metrics like P/E across a sector.

items.name: ticker-tape
items.title: Ticker Tape
items.description: A scrolling stock and crypto ticker tape with BTC, ETH, TAO and NVDA, green up and red down, paused on hover, for headers and trading dashboards.

items.name: trade-tape
items.title: Trade Tape
items.description: A live time and sales tape for trading terminals, streaming prints coloured by side and sized by volume, with block trades highlighted.

items.name: simple-chart
items.title: Mini Price Chart
items.description: A compact crypto price card with one line and one number that follows your pointer, for wallets, exchanges and market widgets.

items.name: matrix-ticker-board
items.title: Matrix Ticker Board
items.description: A dot matrix stock price board drawn on canvas, where changed digits dissolve and redraw on each quote, for trading floors and landing pages.

items.name: request-log
items.title: API Request Log
items.description: An API request log for developer dashboards, with method, path, status and latency per call and the response body unfolding inline.

items.name: new-items-pill
items.title: New Items Pill
items.description: A live trade feed that holds your place while new rows arrive and counts them into a pill, for tapes, alerts and activity feeds.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Notification Inbox
items.description: A notification inbox for SaaS and trading apps, with unread markers that clear as you read and a mark all as read action.

items.name: project-index
items.title: Project Index
items.description: A list of companies or projects where each row shows its cover beside the cursor on hover, for fund portfolios and case study pages.

items.name: news-card
items.title: News Card
items.description: A market news card that cycles headlines with their source and time, for trading dashboards, broker apps and crypto portals.

items.name: alert-stack
items.title: Alert Stack
items.description: A stacked notification panel for price alerts, margin warnings and order fills that fans open on hover and settles as you dismiss.

items.name: assets-balance-card
items.title: Assets Balance Card
items.description: A portfolio balance card with rolling odometer digits and an intraday chart you can drag taller, for crypto wallets and banking apps.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: An onboarding checklist for developer and fintech products, with steps that check off and a progress bar counting what is done.

items.name: preferences-card
items.title: Preferences Card
items.description: An account settings card with rows for profile, payment method and notifications, for SaaS, banking and exchange account pages.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: An empty state for trading and fintech dashboards: a quiet dotted field with one line of copy and one call to action.

items.name: swap-ticket
items.title: Swap Ticket
items.description: A token swap widget for DEX and crypto wallet apps, with an editable amount, a flip button, a token picker and slippage settings.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A segmented control for timeframes and view modes like 24h, 7d and 30d, with a thumb that slides between the options.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: An overlapping avatar stack for teams, signers or token holders that lifts and names one on hover and lists the overflow.

items.name: amount
items.title: Currency Amount
items.description: Currency and crypto amount formatters that keep symbols, decimals, abbreviations and signed colours consistent across a fintech screen.

items.name: crypto-fiat
items.title: Crypto/Fiat
items.description: A crypto amount input that switches between fiat and token units at the current rate, for wallets, exchanges and payment flows.

items.name: screen-shuffle
items.title: Screen Shuffle
items.description: A stack of product screenshots that rotates the front screen to the back, for SaaS and fintech landing page heroes.

items.name: mouse-trail-cta
items.title: Mouse-Trail CTA
items.description: A call to action button whose glow is fed by a cursor particle trail, for the landing page hero of an AI or fintech product.

items.name: ascii-turntable
items.title: ASCII Turntable
items.description: A 3D logo or token mark drawn in ASCII characters that turns with the cursor, for crypto, AI and developer tool landing pages.

items.name: metal-badge
items.title: Metal Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a domed chrome badge, drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat chrome face where WebGPU is missing.

items.name: stone-badge
items.title: Stone Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a carved stone badge, drawn in WebGPU: facets, fissures and mineral speckle on a roughened dome. It leans toward the cursor with the key light following, and a click flips it. Falls back to a flat stone face where WebGPU is missing.

items.name: gold-badge
items.title: Gold Badge
items.description: The metal badge in gold: any SVG mark as a domed, brushed gold badge drawn in WebGPU. It leans toward the cursor with the light following, and a click flips it.

items.name: holo-badge
items.title: Holographic Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a holographic badge: a silver dome under a thin film whose colour shifts with the angle, with a fine sparkle. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: glass-badge
items.title: Glass Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a frosted glass badge: translucent, with the light catching its rolled edge and the page showing through. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: neon-badge
items.title: Neon Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a dark badge with a neon outline that glows and breathes. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: lightning-badge
items.title: Lightning Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a dark glass badge with lightning crawling over its face. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: ascii-badge
items.title: ASCII Badge
items.description: Any SVG mark as a domed badge drawn in characters: the lit surface is read per cell and each cell's brightness picks a character from the ramp, so the letters change with the light as it turns. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

items.name: account-dropdown
items.title: Account Dropdown
items.description: A crypto wallet account switcher that lists each address with its balance and share of the total, for multi wallet web3 apps.

items.name: depth-chart
items.title: Depth Chart
items.description: A market depth chart for crypto exchanges showing bid and ask liquidity around the mid price, with a readout of size on each side.

items.name: gantt-mini
items.title: Gantt Chart
items.description: A compact Gantt chart for sprint and release planning, with a today line and the dates, length and owner of each task on hover.

items.name: leverage-ticket
items.title: Leverage Ticket
items.description: A perpetual futures order ticket with margin, long or short and a leverage slider that updates position size, fees and the liquidation price.

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order Book
items.description: A crypto exchange order book with bids, asks and depth bars, reading the cumulative size and value up to any price level.

items.name: quick-ticket
items.title: Quick Ticket
items.description: A watchlist row that expands into a quick order ticket for market and limit orders, for broker and stock trading apps.

items.name: setup-stepper
items.title: Setup Stepper
items.description: A setup stepper for onboarding flows like domain verification or API setup, with numbered steps down a rail and a Continue action.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: An AI agent tool call card that shows the arguments, result, duration and status of one call, with a run again action.

items.name: vitals-strip
items.title: Key Stats Strip
items.description: A key stats strip for a stock page with price, market cap, index weight, volume and P/E, each figure showing its formula on hover.

items.name: agent-run-timeline
items.title: Agent Run Timeline
items.description: An AI agent run timeline that shows each step with its tool call, duration and status, with the input and output one click away.

items.name: automation-builder
items.title: Automation Builder
items.description: A trading automation builder that writes a strategy as sentences, from news sentiment to orders, with editable values and a test run.

items.name: dialog-stack
items.title: Dialog Stack
items.description: Stacked dialogs for multi step confirmations like plan changes, approvals and sign off, where each step layers on top and Escape steps back.

items.name: graph-comparison
items.title: Graph Comparison
items.description: A stock comparison chart that indexes up to four tickers to the same start, for relative performance from 1M to 1Y.

items.name: market-shelf
items.title: Market Shelf
items.description: A row of crypto market tiles with price, daily change and a 7 day sparkline, for exchange and portfolio home screens.

items.name: order-ticket
items.title: Order Ticket
items.description: A buy and sell order form for limit and market orders where price, amount and total stay in sync, for crypto exchanges and broker apps.

items.name: radial-gauge
items.title: Radial Gauge
items.description: A radial gauge for pass rates like model evals, health checks or compliance tests, with fail, watch and pass bands you can read.

items.name: stacked-bars
items.title: Stacked Bar Chart
items.description: A stacked bar chart of monthly totals by series, shown with AI inference spend by model, reading value and share on hover.

items.name: top-coins
items.title: Top Coins
items.description: A top cryptocurrencies widget with Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana prices and sparklines over 3M to 1Y, scrubbable for any week.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume Profile
items.description: A volume profile chart of traded volume by price with the point of control and value area, for futures and crypto traders.

items.name: allocation-treemap
items.title: Allocation Treemap
items.description: A portfolio allocation treemap with holdings sized by weight, reading the share and value of each position on hover.

items.name: event-feed
items.title: Market Event Feed
items.description: A market events feed grouped by day, each headline with its ticker, price and move, for stock research and trading dashboards.

items.name: info-card
items.title: Info Card
items.description: A small callout card with a title, one line and an action row, for help prompts and upsells in a dashboard sidebar.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: An accessible modal dialog for confirmations like cancelling orders or revoking API keys, with a focus trap and Escape to close.

items.name: payment-card
items.title: Payment Card
items.description: A saved payment card for billing and banking settings that lifts out of its pocket to show the card face, with an update card form.

items.name: release-feed
items.title: Release Feed
items.description: A changelog feed for developer tools and APIs that groups release notes by added, changed and fixed, with copyable versions.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat Tile
items.description: Compact stat tiles for trading metrics like net P&L, win rate and Sharpe ratio, each with a sparkline you scrub for any point.

items.name: total-balance
items.title: Total Balance
items.description: A total balance chart for crypto and banking accounts with windows from 24h to All, reading balance, change and drawdown at any point.

items.name: wallet-drawer
items.title: Wallet Drawer
items.description: A crypto wallet drawer with holdings, DeFi positions and activity, plus send, receive and settings views, for web3 apps.

items.name: amount-slider
items.title: Amount Slider
items.description: An amount slider for choosing a share of a balance with 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent presets, for trade, withdraw and stake forms.

items.name: cross-chain-swap
items.title: Cross Chain Swap
items.description: A cross chain bridge and swap widget for moving tokens between networks like Ethereum, Solana and Arbitrum, reversible in one click.

items.name: execution-controls
items.title: Execution Controls
items.description: A hold to confirm order button for trading apps that shows the order as working, filled or rejected, with a timed undo.

items.name: inline-slider
items.title: Inline Slider
items.description: A range filter slider with its label and value inside the track, for screeners and GPU marketplaces filtering memory, cores and price.

items.name: model-comparison
items.title: Model Comparison
items.description: An LLM comparison table of quality, latency, cost per million tokens and context window, showing each gap to the best model.

items.name: performance-chart
items.title: Performance Chart
items.description: A portfolio performance chart against a benchmark index, shaded green while ahead and red while behind, with the gap on any day.

items.name: scatter-plot
items.title: Scatter Plot
items.description: A risk and return scatter plot of stocks by volatility and yearly return, naming each point with a hairline to both axes.

items.name: swap-confirm
items.title: Swap Confirm
items.description: A stock swap confirmation that sells one holding for another, showing the rate and the minimum received before you confirm.

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime Bars
items.description: A 90 day uptime status chart for APIs and inference services, reading the uptime and incident of any day on hover.

items.name: watchlist-stack
items.title: Watchlist Stack
items.description: A stock watchlist with an intraday sparkline, price and daily move per ticker, scrubbable for the price at any moment.

items.name: approval-quorum
items.title: Approval Quorum
items.description: A multisig approval widget for treasury and payment releases, where risk, treasury and compliance sign off until the quorum is met.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A date range picker with two month calendars and presets like last 7, 30 and 90 days, for analytics, reporting and trade history filters.

items.name: flow-bars
items.title: Net Flow Bars
items.description: A net flow bar chart for daily ETF, exchange or wallet inflows and outflows, where dragging across days sums the run.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A kanban board for engineering, ops and compliance work with three columns and counts, moving a card forward in one click.

items.name: morph-disclosure
items.title: Morph Disclosure
items.description: An expandable row that opens in place into a short sheet of summary and key facts, for product, strategy or company listings.

items.name: positions-table
items.title: Positions Table
items.description: An open positions table for futures and margin trading with entry, mark, liquidation price and unrealised P&L, plus hold to close.

items.name: series-spotlight
items.title: Series Spotlight
items.description: A multi line chart of twelve crypto assets with one highlighted at a time, for comparing coins without losing the one you track.

items.name: tape-flow
items.title: Order Flow
items.description: An order flow chart of the last 48 trades as bars sized by volume and coloured by side, for crypto and futures trading terminals.

items.name: view-switch
items.title: View Switch
items.description: A view switcher for desktop, mobile and code previews where only the selected option shows its label, for docs and component galleries.

items.name: portfolio-book
items.title: Portfolio Overview (paid screen)
items.description: The balance-first book on one ruled grid: holdings, history and share-of-total composed from six library components, with the page composing and never editing them.

items.name: portfolio-allocation
items.title: Portfolio Allocation (paid screen)
items.description: Composition first. Leads with what the book is made of and how concentrated it is, which is the analyst's first question rather than the owner's.

items.name: portfolio-tiers
items.title: Multi-account Portfolio (paid screen)
items.description: The book as four accounts rather than one balance. One pill per tier under the bar, and the pill row is a selector rather than decoration, carrying share-of-total on the tier.

items.name: discover-board
items.title: Market Discovery (paid screen)
items.description: The browsing problem, not the reporting one: filters and a trending rail for finding something you do not already hold.

items.name: discover-screener
items.title: Token Screener (paid screen)
items.description: The screener take on discovery: a dense sortable board where the row is the unit and the filters carry the state.

items.name: terminal-cex
items.title: Trading Terminal (paid screen)
items.description: An exchange terminal on one ruled workspace: candle chart under an interval bar, book or tape as tabs, ticket and account on the right, and a full-width positions register at the fold.

items.name: gpu-pods
items.title: GPU Marketplace (paid screen)
items.description: A GPU rental marketplace's browse screen: 150 pods in a 15-column table you can sort, search and cross-read, with a filter rail whose counts are honest and a product rail of its own. White on black, no accent hue.

items.name: wallet-home
items.title: Crypto Wallet (paid screen)
items.description: A self-custody wallet's home and coin pages in one screen: balance, four actions, every coin by share, and a coin's own chart, position and activity one click away, with a working swap beside them.

items.name: business-balances
items.title: Business Balances (paid screen)
items.description: A business account's cash across five currencies: one total in any display currency, scheduled money in and out, idle cash moved into yield, and transfers, conversions and payment links that update the balances they touch.

items.name: payout-balance
items.title: Payout Balance (paid screen)
items.description: A seller's balance and its ledger: available, reserved and treasury money as one split, and every payment, refund and payout in a filterable, reorderable table, with deposit, withdraw and move flows that write new rows.

items.name: money-account
items.title: Multi-currency Account (paid screen)
items.description: A personal account across four currencies: the total, the month's money in and out, a balance per currency with its own account details, and send, add money and request flows that stack as sheets.

items.name: wealth-invest
items.title: Wealth Portfolio (paid screen)
items.description: A household's investments against the market: portfolio growth drawn against four benchmarks, every holding in one sortable table, and an assistant whose answers cite the numbers and the sources they come from.

items.name: asset-alerts
items.title: Asset and Alerts (paid screen)
items.description: One asset's page with its price alerts: the day's line green above the open and red below it, the position, a swap card, and an alerts panel to search, sort, switch on and off and create from.

items.name: ascii-scroll-morph
items.title: ASCII Scroll Morph (paid screen)
items.description: An immersive landing page with live 3D ASCII shapes that respond to the cursor and transition as you scroll. Adapt the vector artwork, copy and colours in code to fit your brand, while keeping the motion system intact.

items.name: tradeboard-landing
items.title: Trading Platform Landing (paid screen)
items.description: A product landing built on one rule: one ground, one subject, one accent. Giant display headline, the product UI as the hero image, then metric cards, a bento container grid and a three-step band.

items.name: stablecoin-landing
items.title: Stablecoin Landing (paid screen)
items.description: A token landing on the same structure: hero with a brand marquee, a three-card product explainer, a backers marquee and a use-modes grid. Everything structural is shared with the Tradeboard page, so the two stay one system.

items.name: simple-landing
items.title: Developer Tools Landing (paid screen)
items.description: The library's own marketing page: a near-black ground, one object per section, two-tone display type carrying the hierarchy, and every count read live from the registry.
